The brine waste (reject) from the primary RO process is discharged into a 24-inch ocean outline line.

The RO permeate passes through the GAC system and then is blended with groundwater that is treated through a manganese greensand filtration system (for iron and manganese removal) just upstream of the degasifiers.

Backwash waste waters produced by the GAC and manganese greensand filtration systems are discharged to an underground concrete holding basin and subsequently pumped to the SLRWRF via a 42-inch sewer force main.
